title: Morning Sunwatch
text:
☀️ Morning Sunwatch — October 16, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Moderate (C1.8​)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C1.4 (Peaked October 16, 2026 at 11:08 UTC)
🔥 Strongest recent flare: C4.9 (Peaked October 15, 2026 at 15:55 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 438 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 2.33)

Little flare from the Sun! 🔥🚀

A broad coronal-hole-like region and two bright active regions stand out in today’s solar images, with only limited sunspot coverage.

Image: NASA SDO/AIA — 211 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
